overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Dynamic Heming 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a luxurious and health-focused retreat right in your home. Designed for optimal relaxation and wellness, this sauna features 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels that provide soothing heat to help relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and enhance circulation. Constructed from elegant Honey Dark Stain Canadian Hemlock wood, it includes advanced features like an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity for a personalized spa experience. Ideal for indoor spaces such as basements or fitness rooms, this sauna is a perfect addition to your wellness routine.

Dynamic Saunas can be installed on carpet or any indoor location including basements, master baths, walk in closets or can be added to a fitness room.
